title: Jonathan’s Daring Raid

questions.question: Who did Jonathan take with him to attack the Philistine outpost?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:1 (ESV): “...Jonathan... said to the young man who carried his armor, ‘Come, let us go over to the Philistine garrison...’”

questions.question: What sign did Jonathan look for?
options: If they say, "Come up to us," God has given them to us
questions.correctAnswer: If they say, "Come up to us," God has given them to us
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:10 (ESV): “But if they say, ‘Come up to us,’ then we will go up, for the Lord has given them into our hand. And this shall be the sign to us.”

questions.question: What oath did Saul bind the people with?
options: Cursed be the man who eats food until evening
questions.correctAnswer: Cursed be the man who eats food until evening
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:24 (ESV): “...‘Cursed be the man who eats food until it is evening and I am avenged on my enemies.’ So none of the people tasted food.”

questions.question: Who unknowingly broke Saul’s oath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:27 (ESV): “But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the people with the oath, so he put out the tip of the staff... and dipped it in the honeycomb and put his hand to his mouth...”

questions.question: Who saved Jonathan from death?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:45 (ESV): “Then the people said to Saul, ‘Shall Jonathan die...?’ So the people ransomed Jonathan, that he did not die.”

questions.question: How many men did Jonathan and his armor-bearer kill in the first strike?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:14 (ESV): "And that first strike... was about twenty men..."

questions.question: What happened in the Philistine camp after the strike?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:15 (ESV): "And there was a panic in the camp... the earth quaked. It became a very great panic."

questions.question: Who was Ahijah the priest wearing?
What did the people do in their hunger after the battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:32 (ESV): "...took sheep and oxen and calves and slaughtered them on the ground. And the people ate them with the blood."

questions.question: How was Jonathan identified as the one who broke the oath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:41-42 (ESV): "...And Jonathan and Saul were taken... Jonathan was taken."

questions.question: What were the names of the two crags?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:4 (ESV): "...The name of the one crag was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh."

questions.question: Jonathan said, "Nothing can hinder the Lord from saving by ______ or by ______."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:6 (ESV): "...for nothing can hinder the LORD from saving by many or by few."

questions.question: Who was the commander of Saul's army?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:50 (ESV): "...The name of the commander of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul's uncle."

questions.question: What did Saul build for the first time in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 14:35 (ESV): "And Saul built an altar to the LORD; it was the first altar that he built to the LORD."

questions.question: Why did God not answer Saul that day?
options: Because of Jonathan's sin (breaking the oath)
questions.correctAnswer: Because of Jonathan's sin (breaking the oath)
questions.explanation: Implied by 14:37-41 (God didn't answer, Saul cast lots to find the sin, Jonathan was taken).

key_verse_text: ...Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the LORD will work for us, for nothing can hinder the LORD from saving by many or by few. (ESV)
